problem_disposition.summary: deja-vu's Sweep stage needs a lane that answers "did someone already ship this as an installable agent skill?" without deja-vu building and maintaining its own skill-discovery index.

candidate_comparisons.summary: npx skills / vercel-labs/skills is an open, actively maintained CLI and index for discovering installable Claude agent skills. It solves a different, narrower problem than deja-vu (skill discovery, not prior-art verdicts), so it was wired in as a lane rather than treated as a competitor.
evidence_refs: gh api repos/vercel-labs/skills verified 2026-09-11: license MIT, stargazers_count 31266, archived false, pushed_at 2026-09-08T17:31:59Z

uncertainty.residual: vercel-labs/skills' index freshness and coverage of niche/internal skills is unverified beyond spot checks; a miss there degrades this lane to a false negative, not a false positive, so it is run alongside (not instead of) the general-web lane.
uncertainty.confidence: high — MIT license and 30k+-star, actively-pushed repo clear the license and health bars judge.md sets for a commodity dependency

reversibility: high — the lane is one blind-parallel subprocess call (`npx skills search`); dropping vercel-labs/skills only removes one lane's coverage and requires no data migration or API contract change elsewhere in deja-vu

route_components.output_boundary: Stage 3 (Sweep) lane output: a list of matching installable skills for the current hunt's vocabulary, merged into the sweep's candidate list like any other lane
policy_clauses: MIT license permits invocation via its published CLI without redistributing its source
accepted_obligations: keep the `npx skills search` invocation string in SKILL.md/lanes.md in sync with vercel-labs/skills' current CLI surface
route_components.residual_uncertainty: index coverage/freshness for narrow or private-registry skills is unverified
route_components.next_action: none — lane is live; re-verify the CLI invocation still matches vercel-labs/skills' README if a lane failure is ever reported
